source.title: Handbook on Common Fishing Gears in Major Bays of CALABARZON
source.publisher: Department of Agriculture, National Fisheries Research and Development Institute; output of BFAR Region IV-A National Stock Assessment Program
source.citation: Ramos, M. H., Roque, P. M. A. L., Gatlabayan, L. V., & Amparo, T. M. B. (2024). Handbook on Common Fishing Gears in Major Bays of CALABARZON. Department of Agriculture, National Fisheries Research and Development Institute.

accessAndProvenance.accessStatus: Official NFRDI repository metadata and full 86-page publication reviewed; downloaded PDF was inspected for text and selected page layout, then not retained. Separate Nasugbu, Tayabas, Lamon, Ragay, and Batangas sub-batches visually transcribe 149 finfish label rows across 34 gear blocks; name screens were run against GBIF Backbone. The compound Balayan/Calatagan tables remain pending and geographically unresolved.
accessAndProvenance.publicationContext: The foreword describes years of NSAP Region IV-A data gathering at established landing sites in Batangas and Quezon. The publication does not give a per-gear, per-bay observation period or sampling design in the reviewed fish tables.
accessAndProvenance.tableContext: Municipal and commercial fishing-gear sections include repeated “Species Caught” blocks with named bay/gulf headings. They are gear-specific fisheries context, not a standardized complete checklist.
accessAndProvenance.unresolvedCalibration: Source text extraction contains OCR/layout artifacts in some rows. Five source-named-area batches have been transcribed; the compound Balayan/Calatagan Bay blocks still require transcription and name screening. Six Batangas source labels are genus-level sp. identifications. GBIF matches do not authenticate field identifications.

reuse.sourceTerms: The publication states that reproduction and dissemination for educational or other non-commercial purposes are authorized with full acknowledgment; resale or other commercial reproduction is prohibited.
reuse.projectDecision: No images or tables are reproduced. Public app projection remains unapproved pending species-level extraction, field-identification review, and confirmation that the intended product use remains within the stated non-commercial terms.

interpretation.fisheryEvidence: The handbook explicitly lists catch labels by gear and named major fishing ground; this supports a regional fishery-research lead and not a capture point, date-specific occurrence, abundance trend, or current-presence claim.
interpretation.bayScope: The bay/gulf headings are retained as source-described fisheries areas. The compound label “Balayan/Calatagan Bay” is not split into separate site-specific catch lists by this source.
interpretation.nonFishTaxa: Some “Species Caught” blocks include invertebrate taxa. They must remain separate from finfish species and must not be counted as fish.
interpretation.dietAndBait: Gear/target-catch context is not evidence of natural diet, recommended bait, or catchability for an individual fisher.

nextAction: Transcribe the compound Balayan/Calatagan Bay heading exactly as printed, keep it as an unresolved combined area, and do not allocate labels to the two physical bays without independent source evidence.
